  WHY: Operators may incorrectly configure skip behavior because the deletion bound is part of the small-diff route requirement.
- agents.md:98-101 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Documentation for Claude-fixer mode contains a run-on sentence ("...and also runs it). [claude-intervention] and ...").
  WHY: The missing sentence break makes the new logic difficult for operators to parse.
